title: Will Kacmarek 2026 NFL Draft Profile - NewsBreak
text:
By Trey Daubert ,
9 hours ago Ohio State tight end Will Kacmarek gets a spin through the 2026 NFL Draft profile machine. Check out the report inside the article! (Grok) Will Kacmarek 2026 NFL Draft Profile Yeah, man, or girl, whoever is visiting the site. We’re in the weeds here with this one. It’s the other Ohio State tight end’s turn for the 2026 NFL Draft profile series. Comments are open, but let’s have a chat about Will Kacmarek!
Stock Report: Senior Bowl Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes
Kacmarek, 23, checks in at 6-foot-5, 261. The St. Louis, Missouri, native was a two star defensive line recruit during the 2021 cycle. Although, Kacmarek made the switch to tight end pretty early in his college career. After signing with the Ohio Bobcats, he was a contributor at TE right away.
As a freshman, Kacmarek notched 20 receptions for 264 yards while failing to find the end zone. The follow year, his last year at Ohio, he posted 22 receptions for 243 yards and two scores. That’s when he moved up a level and transferred to Ohio State.
In 2024, he was the backup to Gee Scott. Kacmarek hauled in eight receptions for 86 yards. This past year, he was the backup to Max Klare and recorded 15 receptions for 168 yards and two scores. Obviously, the production isn’t blowing anyone away here.
Kacmarek got a Senior Bowl invite, but I can’t imagine anyone was blown away by what he showed there. It seems like all the tight ends there had the same theme. Literally all of them in that group had brick hands, and he exemplified that. Didn’t look weak in terms of pushing off creating separation, but his hands were brutal at that event.
Bottom line here is that we’re really talking about a blocking tight end. He blocks fine. That’s not the problem. He’s just not going to stretch the field or do anything relevant as a pass catcher. That’s the archetype of the player. I don’t make the rules, the universe does…
At the Combine , Kacmarek showed me pretty much everything I knew going in. Looks alright blocking. Just not nearly good enough to be a factor as a pass catcher.
Sam Roush 2026 NFL Draft Profile Can’t imagine anyone is using a draft pick here. You’re going to fork over a draft pick for the backup tight end at Ohio State who is a defensive lineman conversion story? I’m not doing it. Undraftable grade for me.
